=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2464-2465 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: WORKSPACE_SAFETY_CHECK_HELPER resolves to only one hard-coded path and can skip the workspace safety preflight when the helper is staged elsewhere.
  WHY: In consumer-repo called-workflow runs the `[ -x ... ]` guard never finds the helper outside `scripts/`, so `WORKSPACE_REUSE_ENABLED=true` no longer guarantees enforcement.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2772-2786 and 3510-3524 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The DISCOVER/DIAGNOSE exit-78 handlers call `fail_validate_codex_phase()`, which exits 1 and discards the workspace_safety_violation exit code.
  WHY: Callers only observe exit 1 instead of the required deterministic 78 signal, so safety violations are misclassified as generic failures.
- scripts/workspace_safety_check.sh:57-60 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `pwd -P` comparison is ineffective in reused-workspace shells because `BASH_ENV` can already cd into `WORKSPACE_PATH` before the helper runs.
  WHY: The helper sees the post-`BASH_ENV` cwd, so a launch-directory mismatch can be masked and the intended `workspace_safety_violation` never fires.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Preserve the plan's independent-mergeability rule: enforce only when workspace reuse is enabled; legacy non-W1 paths fail open."
  expected_change_site: scripts/validate_process.sh line 2464 (WORKSPACE_SAFETY_CHECK_HELPER resolution)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The helper resolution has no fallback candidate loop. In consumer-repo called-workflow runs where workspace_safety_check.sh is not staged to scripts/, the safety check silently skips even when WORKSPACE_REUSE_ENABLED is true. The fail-open contract is met (the guard is there), but the enforcement side of the contract — actually running the check when reuse is enabled and the helper is available somewhere — is weakened because the helper is only looked up in one path while LEDGER_SUBSTATE_HELPER searches four.
- requirement: "Escaping the workspace root or using an invalid workspace key fails with workspace_safety_violation / exit 78."
  expected_change_site: scripts/validate_process.sh lines 2777 and 3515 (the exit 78 handlers)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: Both the DISCOVER and DIAGNOSE exit-78 handlers call fail_validate_codex_phase() which unconditionally exits 1. The acceptance criterion's deterministic exit 78 signal is not preserved end-to-end through the validate workflow path.
- requirement: "Escaping the workspace root or using an invalid workspace key fails with workspace_safety_violation / exit 78."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workspace_safety_check.sh (the pwd -P mismatch guard)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The pwd -P comparison guard (lines 57-60 of workspace_safety_check.sh) is present syntactically but is functionally unreachable in reused-workspace mode because BASH_ENV auto-cd happens before the helper runs. In reuse mode, `pwd -P` already equals `WORKSPACE_PATH` at check time, so the mismatch detection guard never fires. The test suite (`test_helper_rejects_pwd_mismatch`) exercises this path but does not emulate the BASH_ENV auto-cd contract that exists on real runners, so the test passes while the runtime guard is disabled. A fix would require consulting OLDPWD or the actual launch directory before BASH_ENV takes effect.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/validate_process.sh
  Line or code reference: line 2777 and line 3515 (both call fail_validate_codex_phase when DISCOVER_EXIT or DIAGNOSE_EXIT equals 78)
  Problem: When the workspace safety check returns exit 78, the handler calls fail_validate_codex_phase which unconditionally exits 1. The acceptance criterion requires workspace_safety_violation / exit 78 so callers can distinguish safety violations from generic Codex failures. The validate_process.sh handler discards the deterministic exit code.
  Why it fails at runtime: Any orchestrator or caller that inspects the exit code of the validate workflow sees exit 1 instead of 78. The workspace_safety_violation signal is lost. In the DISCOVER path, DISCOVER_EXIT captures 78 from run_validate_codex_attempt via return $? but fail_validate_codex_phase then hardcodes exit 1. Same in the DIAGNOSE path.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

- File: scripts/validate_process.sh
  Line or code reference: line 2464
  Problem: WORKSPACE_SAFETY_CHECK_HELPER resolves to exactly one path with no fallback candidate loop, unlike LEDGER_SUBSTATE_HELPER at lines 2465-2472 which searches four candidate directories.
  Why it fails at runtime: In consumer-repo called-workflow runs, validate.yml does not stage workspace_safety_check.sh into the scripts/ directory, so the [ -x ... ] guard silently skips the safety preflight even when WORKSPACE_REUSE_ENABLED is true. The LEDGER_SUBSTATE_HELPER pattern shows the established approach: check .codex-workflow-src/scripts/ and .codex-workflow-src-main/scripts/ fallbacks.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- File: scripts/workspace_safety_check.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 57-60 (pwd -P check after BASH_ENV auto-cd)
  Problem: When WORKSPACE_REUSE_ENABLED is true and BASH_ENV is set, bash sources BASH_ENV before executing the helper script. If BASH_ENV contains cd "${WORKSPACE_PATH}" (as it does in reused-workspace shells), the shell has already changed directory to WORKSPACE_PATH before the helper's pwd -P check runs, so the mismatch path is unreachable in reuse mode.
  Why it fails at runtime: A launch-directory mismatch that should trigger workspace_safety_violation / exit 78 is silently masked. The helper observes the post-BASH_ENV-cd directory, not the original launch directory. The Python-based root-not-in-parents check catches path-escape violations, but the pwd mismatch check (a secondary defense) is dead code when BASH_ENV auto-cd is active.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- File: scripts/workspace_safety_check.sh
  Code: lines 57–60, current_dir="$(pwd -P 2>/dev/null)" check
  Problem: In reused-workspace environments where BASH_ENV masks the launch directory by auto-cding into $WORKSPACE_PATH, pwd -P yields WORKSPACE_PATH even when the real launch directory was somewhere else. This breaks the intended check that verifies the current directory matches the resolved workspace path.
  Why it fails at runtime: reused-workspace shells perform: source BASH_ENV -> cd $WORKSPACE_PATH -> bash script -> pwd -P equals $WORKSPACE_PATH -> helper returns success even when the original launch directory was outside the workspace — the invariant is silently bypassed.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- File: scripts/validate_process.sh
  Code: lines 2772–2786 (DISCOVER_EXIT==78 handler) and lines 3510–3524 (DIAGNOSE_EXIT==78 handler)
  Problem: The workspace-safety preflight exits 78 on violation, but both DISCOVER and DIAGNOSE phases call fail_validate_codex_phase() which unconditionally exits 1 after writing status markers. This loses the deterministic exit code.
  Why it fails at runtime: any caller (including orchestrator scripts) only sees exit 1, not the required exit 78 signal that indicates workspace_safety_violation vs. a generic Codex crash. Recovery logic that depends on the specific exit code misclassifies this failure.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- File: scripts/validate_process.sh
  Code: lines 2464–2465
  Problem: WORKSPACE_SAFETY_CHECK_HELPER only resolves to a single hard-coded path "${_validate_script_dir}/workspace_safety_check.sh" without fallback candidates like .codex-workflow-src/scripts/ or .codex-workflow-src-main/scripts/.
  Why it fails at runtime: in called workflow / consumer-repo runs where validate.yml does not stage workspace_safety_check.sh into scripts/, the [ -x ... ] guard silently fails and the safety preflight never runs, even when WORKSPACE_REUSE_ENABLED=true. No fallback equivalent to LEDGER_SUBSTATE_HELPER candidate checking exists.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
